name: Laird
summary: At Auberdine's inn, Laird sells fish and cooking supplies to travelers along Darkshore's coast.

sections.title: A Harbor Merchant
sections.body: Laird sells fish and supplies inside Auberdine's inn. Sailors, locals, and travelers come to him while Darkshore's waters churn with dangers greater than those along Teldrassil's sheltered shores. For anglers willing to cast from the misty beaches, the local catch can bring a handsome profit.

sections.title: Ties Across the Water
sections.body: Laird stays in touch with fishing operations across the channel in Teldrassil. Shipments come from his fellow fisher Nessa Shadowsong, linking Rut'theran Village with the mainland port and keeping coastal trade moving.

faq.answer: Find Laird inside Auberdine's inn, on the ground floor. Auberdine is the main Alliance settlement on Darkshore's coast.
Laird sells caught fish, cooking ingredients, and instruction for preparing a Fillet of Frenzy.
Laird receives a delivery from Nessa Shadowsong at Rut'theran Village. Afterward, he asks adventurers to carry word back across the sea.

faq.q: Why does Laird think Darkshore fishing is worthwhile despite the danger?
faq.answer: Though Darkshore's misty shoreline is more dangerous than Teldrassil's tranquil waters, its abundant and exotic sea life makes fishing more profitable for enterprising fishers.

angles.text: If you travel through Darkshore for cooking, Laird teaches how to fillet and cook the fierce frenzy fish found in Kalimdor's waters.
As a night elf, Laird shows how your people trade along Kalimdor's mainland shores and support the growing coastal network.
